fact: The 2017 National Broadband Strategy and 2018 Information Society Policy remained largely aspirational because of limited implementation and lack of clear, actionable guidance and funding; IDA agreed to finance the USD 200 million Mozambique Digital Acceleration Project to expand broadband.
title: Quadro de Política para Reassentamento (QPR), Projecto de Aceleração Digital de Moçambique (P176459), Draft
